title: Dense subsites induce equivalent sheaf categories
statement: Let $u : C \to D$ be a fully faithful functor between sites with Grothendieck topologies $J$ on $C$ and $K$ on $D$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Suppose that every object of $D$ has a $K$-covering sieve generated by morphisms $u(U)\to X$ with $U$ in $C$, and that $J$ is the topology induced by $u$: a sieve $R$ on $U$ is $J$-covering iff the sieve on $u(U)$ generated by the $u(r)$, $r\in R$, is $K$-covering. Let $A$ be a category having limits of shape $(X\downarrow u^{op})$ for every object $X$ of $D^{op}$ (for example $A$ the category of sets or of abelian groups, with $C$ and $D$ small). Then restriction $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G\circ u^{op}$ is an equivalence of categories $\operatorname{Sh}(D,K;A)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Sh}(C,J;A)$.
